result:
The change that fixed the message is PR #376 (merged 2026-10-02, merge commit `f462a28`), which fixes O3-5993. The bug was a single-brace placeholder: the snackbar string used `{parameters}`, but i18next only interpolates `{{parameters}}`, so the literal text was shown instead of the missing parameter labels. The PR changed the string to `{{parameters}}` in the English source and the call site now passes the labels in.

The line that implements it is `openmrs-esm-admin-tools/packages/esm-reports-app/src/components/reports-data-overview.component.tsx:77`. It builds the list of required parameters with no value (lines 69–71) and passes them as `parameters` to the `missingParameters` message (lines 74–80).

The corrected string itself is in `openmrs-esm-admin-tools/packages/esm-reports-app/translations/en.json:34`.

Caveats:
- A reviewer (greptile-apps) flagged that the Chinese overrides (`zh`, `zh_CN`) still lack `{{parameters}}`, so Chinese users would not see the names. I did not read those files, so I can't confirm the final state. The other reviewer (denniskigen) asked that only `en.json` be changed, since other locales come from Transifex, so the Chinese files were probably left as they were.
- The PR adds a regression test file, `openmrs-esm-admin-tools/packages/esm-reports-app/src/components/reports-data-overview.component.test.tsx` (+104 lines). I did not open it.
- Falkon's PR data lists 104 added test lines in that file but gives no line numbers, so it is not in the array below.

Evidence, best first:
1. `openmrs-esm-admin-tools/packages/esm-reports-app/src/components/reports-data-overview.component.tsx:77` — the call that shows the message with the parameter names.
2. `openmrs-esm-admin-tools/packages/esm-reports-app/translations/en.json:34` — the corrected `{{parameters}}` string.
3. `openmrs-esm-admin-tools/packages/esm-reports-app/src/components/reports-data-overview.component.tsx:69-80` — the missing-parameter check and the snackbar.
4. PR #376 — the fix, its description, and the review thread.
5. Merge commit `f462a28bf6f97d3a1c963e362b79c31b56f69bd4`.
6. Last reviewed commit `83130d5f6c3a4c1f143d3223761875bd6746a7e0` — the head the review comments refer to.
7. Ticket O3-5993.
